gloss: remaining life expectancy; time left to live

definitions.gloss: remaining life expectancy; time left to live
definitions.explanation: The estimated or expected amount of time a person has left to live, typically used in medical contexts when discussing terminal illness or prognosis.

examples.japanese: {余命|よめい}⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I was told I had six months to live.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{余命|よめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げられた→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧。
examples.english: The doctor told me how long I had left to live.

examples.japanese: {余命|よめい}わずか⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{知|し}り→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{残|のこ}り→残り：01622_nokori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{過|す}ごす→過ごす：02062_sugosu⟧ことにした。
examples.english: Learning that I had little time left, I decided to spend the remaining time with my family.

notes:
Refers to the estimated time a person has left to live. Most commonly encountered in medical contexts, particularly when doctors give a prognosis for terminal illness. A serious, weighty word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {余命|よめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to give a life expectancy prognosis
- {余命|よめい}⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧: six months to live
- {余命|よめい}わずか: little time left to live
- {余命|よめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{告|つ}げる→告げる：11808_tsugeru⟧: to inform someone of their remaining lifespan
- ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{余命|よめい}: average life expectancy (statistical term)

USAGE:
In everyday use, {余命|よめい} almost always implies a terminal condition. The pattern {余命|よめい}＋time period＋⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{宣告|せんこく}→宣告：06819_senkoku⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧ is extremely common in both real medical situations and in fiction. In demographic or actuarial contexts, ⟦{平均|へいきん}→平均：03614_heikin⟧{余命|よめい} refers to statistically calculated remaining lifespan.

ETYMOLOGY:
{余|よ} (remaining) + {命|めい} (life) — literally "remaining life."
